projectSummary: Establishes that bench press joint loading is not a fixed property of the exercise: it varies with the lifter's technique, expertise and sex. Any mechanical statement about the bench press therefore needs a technique qualifier.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only, so the reported moment values could not be extracted.

study.population: Thirty-four healthy adults, 12 powerlifters (6 women, 6 men) and 22 recreational lifters (9 women, 13 men), performed a 6-8 repetition maximum set of the bench press while elbow and shoulder net joint moments, moment arms and EMG of six upper-extremity muscles were measured.

title: Understanding Bench Press Biomechanics-Training Expertise and Sex Affect Lifting Technique and Net Joint Moments.
